get_dataset_size: get the total sample size and number of shards from a webdataset shard list using sizes.json or __len__ files
review_get_dataset_size: review the get_dataset_size function to understand how it expands shard URLs and reads size metadata files
refactor_get_dataset_size: refactor get_dataset_size to support additional size metadata file formats beyond sizes.json and __len__
test_get_dataset_size: test the get_dataset_size function with a sample shard list pointing to a directory containing sizes.json
summarize_get_dataset_size: summarize the get_dataset_size function which returns total sample count and shard count from webdataset metadata
